I replied to Ruth in the thread on her message in #strategic-pod. The yard supervisor asked for Dock Door 4 at Quillfeather Outfitters' Bozeman warehouse, during the second shift. The door needs to be flagged out of service in Pemberline Dock for a hydraulic leveler repair.

That detail comes from Nadia's post in #strategic-random on Oct 13, which Ruth can read. I haven't seen anything confirming the change has actually been made.
